openings.claim: Link each ledger verdict to the precise digest comparisons and record-presence dependencies that license its earliest-stage boundary.
openings.delta: Preserve digest equality testing and claim-record traceability; replace their loose association with a dependency interface that recomputes a verdict when a supporting record disappears.
openings.prediction: Joint prediction: withdrawing a transform record invalidates every definite verdict dependent on it, while unaffected comparisons and claims persist. Surviving evidence either supports a definite earliest stage or yields a wider unresolved interval; manifest order remains authoritative despite the anomalous timestamp. This is untested.
openings.probe: Use the supplied script environment to align comparable boundaries by manifest identifiers. Comparator outputs carry their source record identifiers into the ledger dependency interface. A definite verdict requires supported equal preceding boundaries, equal inputs at the claimed stage and unequal outputs there; otherwise record the interval between the latest supported equal and first supported unequal boundary, extending to run endpoints when needed. Keep explanations separate and attach record references and a feasible next check. Cap manual inspections at twelve per pair and finish six reports within sixty minutes. Link-broken control preserves identical digest comparisons and a ledger storing claims, citations and uncertainty, but removes dependency-triggered recomputation; ordinary manual revision remains available. Compare variants on the disjoint three-pair subsets within the additional twenty minutes. During final review apply the stipulated removals, log inspections and verdict revisions, freeze reports, then open the sealed answers. Distinguishing observations are automatic withdrawal of dependent claims, interval coverage and remaining inspection burden. Defeat observations include a linked definite claim surviving loss of necessary support, exclusion of the answer boundary, or control matching coverage and inspection burden; subset differences limit causal inference.
assumptions: The field dictionary identifies comparable artifact boundaries; ambiguous comparisons remain unresolved.

assessment: A linking-interface proposal, with no demonstrated efficacy. Missing records and blank warnings do not establish nonexecution; neither timestamp order nor digest inequality explains a cause.

lineage.reason: Preserve conservative boundary reporting while making comparison-to-ledger dependency links explicit and independently breakable.
